title: M7.P5: Complete exact-candidate cloud scan-page proof
body:
## Qualification reconciliation — 2026-10-11

Actual installed replacement19/ESc8dc72cf9 proof records EN/FR opening and selected-content scans, positive/empty results, actual refused endpoint and same-URL recovery via TRY AGAIN. Reviewed frames, immutable selected context/payload receipts and worker cleanup are retained in [installed UI/source evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-installed-ui). These are replacement19 executions. Full61309-entry image19→20 comparison proves unchanged ES/cloud runtime; corrected20 separately passes78-frame comparison and clean/retained protocol qualification in [corrected clean/upgrade qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-pixelelated-replacement-20).

The earlier remaining-work statements below are historical; the acceptance checklist is reconciled to the evidence above. No owner device/cloud action or publication occurred.

## Current scope — remaining scan-page proof

The current scan reads the selected folder context, settings archive labels and content. Opening backup/restore uses CHECKING YOUR CLOUD; CONTINUE with selected content uses the second content scan. D-CLOUD-175/178/179 removes automatic discovery/settlement; the old cloud_migrate_layout trace and /ROCKNIX fallback cases are retired.

Replacement18 scripts.log section `ab` passes selected-folder, archive facts, separate content scan, offline/busy/failure/invalidation controls. Canonical CF13/CF14 has reviewed cancellation, changed-configuration refusal/retry, positive systems and EN/FR empty-library frames. These do not by themselves prove the complete running/dead-endpoint sequence below.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Source status/order/failure controls pass against replacement18's actual rclone; canonical menu/CF13/CF14 references and approved current translations accompany the retained ES1d76b3d source.
- [x] Cancellation and empty/positive selected-content presentation has reviewed original frames in the cloud-validator index; #533 independently rehashed/reviewed selected frames.
- [x] Next-image EN/FR sequence records menu→running opening scan→options, then selected-content second scan→systems/empty result, with current source live text and no card-over-dialog artifact.
- [x] A synthetic dead endpoint on that image yields the actual failure reason and TRY AGAIN/CLOSE; retry after backend recovery reaches options. Retain frames, original result channels, selected-pointer/payload preservation and worker cleanup.

No source defect is inferred from the missing paired evidence. If the check fails, file/trace the actual defect before changing it. Current strings are already settled; old proposed wording is historical.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Retained synthetic proof is reviewed here; any missing software assertion belongs on the next combined candidate. No personal cloud or owner-device action.

[Disposition and next-build plan](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/releases/next-candidate-scope.md); [replacement18 qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18/qualification.md).


## Original request and history

The complete original body and every comment are preserved in [the #533 snapshot](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/next/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-candidate-scope/tracker-before.json), entry #350. Retired criteria there are historical, not an execution queue. Existing GitHub comments also remain intact.
